character_accessible_information: Reirin is present for the festival and knows her own physical condition and embroidery work.
artifact.description: Reirin participates in the festival as a frail, publicly favored candidate with demonstrated embroidery.
objective_facts: Reirin's embroidery is displayed and judged best among the displayed works.
Narration describes recurrent frailty and close family protection.
artifact.outcome: The protected pre-swap situation is established.

temporal_scope.label: pre-swap protected life through tower fall

artifact.uncertainty: Other women's broad praise is reported opinion, not direct access to Reirin's cognition.

character_accessible_information: Reirin remembers the fall, perceives the unfamiliar body, and recognizes the cell.
artifact.description: Reirin falls from the tower and awakens in confinement in Keigetsu's body.
objective_facts: Reirin falls and later awakens in a body with unfamiliar features in a cell.
artifact.outcome: Character identity remains 黃玲琳 while current body identity becomes 朱慧月.
artifact.uncertainty: The source's speaker attribution is derived; the swap is subsequently corroborated in accessible dialogue.

character_accessible_information: Reirin knows her identity, infers the exchange, and learns that Dongxue believes a diary was stolen.
artifact.description: Reirin attempts and fails to prove her identity to Dongxue under a disclosure restriction.
objective_facts: Speech and writing about the exchange are blocked; Dongxue rejects private identifying facts because of a false diary explanation.
observed_behaviors: Offers private biographical facts to establish identity.
artifact.outcome: The identity proof fails and Reirin remains treated as Keigetsu.

character_accessible_information: Reirin hears the stated motive, method, disclosure constraint, and threat.
artifact.description: Keigetsu tells Reirin that the exchange and disclosure block were intentional.
explicit_statements: Reirin asks why and offers advice for treating her original body's fever.
objective_facts: The person in Reirin's original body claims responsibility for the exchange and threatens Reirin with execution.
artifact.outcome: Reirin's accessible knowledge now includes an asserted intentional exchange.
artifact.uncertainty: The other party's causal account is a statement by an adversarial participant, not independent narrator verification.

character_accessible_information: Reirin directly tests the current body, recalls her illness-management history, envies the health, and recalls duty toward her original body.
artifact.description: Reirin evaluates the healthy borrowed body against her severely frail original body.
objective_facts: The borrowed body has stable pulse and movement while narration describes the original body's recurrent severe illness.
artifact.outcome: She understands a sharp body/health contrast without changing character identity.

character_accessible_information: She knows the danger and explains her learned strategy of not anticipating pain.
artifact.description: Reirin faces the beast-seeking rite and remains behaviorally calm before the lion.
objective_facts: Reirin is placed with a hungry lion and remains standing as it approaches.
artifact.uncertainty: Calm behavior is bounded to this danger context and must not alone establish lifelong fearlessness.

character_accessible_information: Reirin knows how the mouse encountered the poison and treats both deaths as her responsibility.
artifact.description: The lion dies after consuming the poisoned mouse remains kept by Reirin.
objective_facts: The lion consumes poisoned remains and dies; Reirin survives.
artifact.observed_behaviors: Warns the lion, explains the accident, apologizes, and intends burial/prayer.
artifact.outcome: The rite ends without Reirin's death.

character_accessible_information: Reirin hears the acquittal, the continued threat against identity-like behavior, and knows she cannot disclose the swap.
artifact.description: Reirin is declared innocent of the tower attack and resolves to act within her constrained public identity.
objective_facts: The rite formally declares the person publicly identified as Keigetsu innocent of the attack.
artifact.observed_behaviors: Prays for the animals and verbally rallies herself.
artifact.outcome: Execution danger ends, but identity concealment and social hostility continue.

character_accessible_information: Reirin learns Lily's name, vulnerable status, claimed mistreatment, and present refusal.
artifact.description: Lily escorts Reirin to a derelict warehouse and directly refuses service while describing prior abuse.
objective_facts: Reirin is relocated and Lily states that she will not provide household care.
artifact.outcome: Reirin enters a new environment with a hostile attendant relationship.

temporal_scope.label: post-acquittal warehouse relocation and initial self-sufficient living

character_accessible_information: She knows she is isolated, inhabits a healthy body, and explicitly experiences joy and freedom while remembering the wrongful exchange.
artifact.description: Reirin welcomes warehouse isolation as an opportunity for physical activity, autonomy, and open expression.
objective_facts: Reirin is left at the warehouse with overgrown grounds and no immediate supervision.
artifact.observed_behaviors: Runs into the grass, touches the soil, jumps, and speaks loudly.
artifact.outcome: Her active goals shift toward self-sufficient living while the exchange remains unresolved.

temporal_scope.label: post-acquittal warehouse relocation and initial self-sufficient living

character_accessible_information: Reirin participates in the conversation and knows what support is offered and accepted.
artifact.description: Reirin begins clearing the grounds and requests only basic supplies when Chenyu offers help.
objective_facts: Reirin clears vegetation; Chenyu offers intervention or supplies; she asks for salt and receives basic provisions.
artifact.observed_behaviors: Performs manual work, declines broad intervention, and makes a limited practical request.
artifact.outcome: Initial self-sufficient settlement receives minimal material support.

temporal_scope.label: post-acquittal warehouse relocation and initial self-sufficient living

artifact.description: Lily privately accepts an inducement to report on mistreatment of the person believed to be Keigetsu.
objective_facts: Lily accepts rice and a promised promotion for future reports.
artifact.outcome: An undisclosed pressure enters Lily's relationship context.

temporal_scope.label: post-acquittal warehouse relocation and initial self-sufficient living

artifact.uncertainty: This story-level event is inaccessible to Reirin in the allowed source window and is excluded from her Memory and Period domain claims.

character_accessible_information: Reirin knows her own work, book-derived knowledge, enjoyment, and the limited hint she gives Lily; she does not know Lily's private agreement.
artifact.description: Reirin cultivates recovered plants, cooks, shares food with Lily, and gives a constrained identity hint.
objective_facts: Reirin has cleared and organized part of the grounds, identified edible plants, cooked food, and shared it.
artifact.observed_behaviors: Cultivates, cooks, offers food, and avoids falsely claiming use of magic.
artifact.outcome: Lily encounters behavior inconsistent with her prior model of Keigetsu, but Reirin's identity remains undisclosed.

temporal_scope.label: post-acquittal warehouse relocation and initial self-sufficient living
